description: Declares which marketplace plugins carry a delegation bridge (an external-engine teammate that does real work on Claude's behalf). The delegation-integrity CI gate (scripts/check_delegation_proof.py) reads this manifest as its whole contract: a version bump on any listed plugin's marketplace entry requires a schema-valid delegation-proof artifact, and the fleet sweep classifies each recorded proof/transcript against the silent-no-op taxonomy. Add a plugin here to bring it under the gate; no lint-code change is needed.

agy.description: Antigravity-backed coder/reviewer bridge (plugins/agy). A genuine run shells out to the guarded agy wrapper with an explicit --model; the name of the spawn path is NOT a trustworthy signal (LEARNINGS.md #agy-delegate-silent-claude-fallback), so the discriminator below is the transcript-grep the audit operationalizes.
